drivenrides:options_driver: Your private driver drives you there
drivenrides:options_carphysics: Real car physics (off: the older, simpler rides)
drivenrides:options_owncar: Your car drives itself (L in the driver's seat)
drivenrides:options_autopark: At the end of a self-driven trip
drivenrides:options_home_key: Drive home (last residence visited this session) — key
drivenrides:notice_no_pin: Pin a building with Set destination first.
drivenrides:notice_no_home: Visit a residential building first. Home is remembered until you load a game.
drivenrides:notice_destination_key_confl: Choose different keys for pinned building and home in the mod options.
drivenrides:notice_unpark_failed: No clear way to pull out. Take the wheel and try again from the lane.
drivenrides:notice_vanilla_ride: No driving route for this ride. You get there the usual way.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_off: Self-driving is switched off in the mod options.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_street: Drive out onto the street first.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_damaged: The car is too damaged to drive.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_out_of_fuel: The car is out of fuel.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_no_fuel: Not enough fuel for the trip.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_cannot: Your car can't drive itself there.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_lane: Pull into the driving lane, facing the way the traffic goes, first.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_no_route: Your car can't find a way there from this lane.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_no_spot: No free parking spot within {metres} m. Park the car yourself.
drivenrides:notice_owncar_busy: Not while the car drives itself.
drivenrides:notice_bridge_fuel: Not enough fuel to cross the bridge.
